bio: This is a cool alternative to FINE, the fine dining restaurant also located on the first floor of the modern building and accessible by lift. Asian cuisine takes centre stage here, with dishes ranging from shumai prawn dumplings to Iberian pork katsu, white cabbage and carrot salad, ponzu and honey jus; they also lend themselves to sharing. What is more, the bill for these delicious but reasonably priced dishes won't break the bank. The atmosphere is nice and lively and the team provides highly attentive and professional service. Tip: Try one of the tasty cocktails. There is also a simple Easy Lunch deal....
